(()=>{'use strict';
 const navToggle=document.querySelector('.nav-toggle'),nav=document.querySelector('.main-nav');
 navToggle?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=navToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true';navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));navToggle.textContent=open?'Fechar':'Menu';nav.classList.toggle('is-open',open)});
 nav?.querySelectorAll('a,button').forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click',()=>{nav.classList.remove('is-open');navToggle?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(navToggle)navToggle.textContent='Menu'}));
 document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='Escape'&&nav?.classList.contains('is-open')){nav.classList.remove('is-open');navToggle?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(navToggle){navToggle.textContent='Menu';navToggle.focus()}}});
 const dialog=document.querySelector('#contact-dialog'),form=dialog?.querySelector('form'),result=dialog?.querySelector('.form-result');
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-contact]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{form.reset();form.classList.remove('hidden');result.classList.add('hidden');const area=btn.dataset.contact;const select=form.querySelector('[name=area]');if(area&&Array.from(select.options).some(o=>o.value===area))select.value=area;dialog.showModal()}));
 dialog?.querySelector('.dialog-close').addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close());
 dialog?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===dialog){const r=dialog.getBoundingClientRect();if(e.clientX<r.left||e.clientX>r.right||e.clientY<r.top||e.clientY>r.bottom)dialog.close()}});
 form?.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!form.reportValidity())return;form.classList.add('hidden');result.replaceChildren();const strong=document.createElement('strong');strong.textContent='Contato de exemplo preparado.';const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent='Você percorreu o fluxo de contato da demonstração. A integração com o CRM deste navegador verifica o registro a seguir. Nenhuma mensagem será enviada e nenhuma consulta será marcada.';const link=document.createElement('a');link.className='text-link';link.href='../crm.html?nicho=advocacia';link.textContent='Conhecer o CRM jurídico →';result.append(strong,p,link);document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vereda:demo-inquiry',{detail:{name:form.elements.nome?.value,context:form.elements.area?.value,result:p}}));result.classList.remove('hidden');result.tabIndex=-1;result.focus()});
})();
